gizmo.title: Alemanaka
gizmo.description: Hōʻike i nā hanana ma kekahi faila alemanaka ma ke ʻano he mau kāleka lā, he laina manawa, he papa, a i ʻole he papa helu.

configure.title: Faila alemanaka
configure.description: Hoʻouka a koho paha i kekahi faila alemanaka .ics. Heluhelu ʻia kona mau hanana ma ka polokalamu kele pūnaewele.

configure.title: Hōʻike ma ke ʻano
configure.description: Pehea e hōʻike ai i nā mea i loko o ka faila.

configure.title: Poʻo
configure.description: Hōʻike ʻia ma luna o nā hanana, a ma ke ʻano he lepili no ka papa. Hoʻohana paʻamau ʻia ka inoa ponoʻī o ka alemanaka.
